response.text: The AP-to-GL check returned two invoices whose journal liability credit doesn't match the invoice amount. Let me look at those more closely, check the period columns, and check payments against invoices.

arguments.sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" IN (1192, 2064) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID" = i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING (i."STAT_CD"='P' AND ABS(COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) - i."INV_AMT") > 0.005) OR (i."STAT_CD"='O' AND COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) <> 0)
